instruction: Pass extra vars to Ansible provisioner
Set Ansible inventory path in Vagrant
Enable Ansible verbose mode in Vagrant
Set Ansible limit in Vagrant provisioner
Disable auto-generated Ansible inventory in Vagrant
Use the Chef provisioner in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "chef_solo" do |chef| chef.cookbooks_path = "cookbooks" chef.add_recipe "nginx" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Chef client with a Chef server URL
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "chef_client" do |chef| chef.chef_server_url = "https://chef.example.com" chef.validation_key_path = "validation.pem" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use the Puppet provisioner in Vagrant
Use Puppet with server mode
Use the Docker provisioner in Vagrant
Run a Docker container via Vagrant provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "docker" do |docker| docker.run "nginx", image: "nginx:latest", args: "-p 80:80" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Build a Docker image via Vagrant provisioner
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "docker" do |docker| docker.build_image "/vagrant/app", args: "-t myapp:latest" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use the Salt provisioner in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "salt" do |salt| salt.masterless = true salt.minion_config = "minion.conf" salt.run_highstate = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Use the CFEngine provisioner in Vagrant
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "cfengine" do |cf| cf.mode = "bootstrap" cf.am_policy_hub = true end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Add a custom synced folder in Vagrant
Set synced folder owner and group
Set synced folder with NFS type
Set synced folder with rsync type
Disable default synced folder
Set synced folder mount options
Use SMB synced folder type (Windows)
Set synced folder to automatically enable NFS exports
Create a multi-machine Vagrant setup (two VMs)
output: echo 'Vagrant.configure("2") do |config| config.vm.define "web" do |web| web.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" end config.vm.define "db" do |db| db.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" end end' > Vagrantfile

instruction: Set default provider for multi-machine setup
Configure a VM as the primary in multi-machine
output: echo 'config.vm.define "web", primary: true do |web| web.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" end' >> Vagrantfile
